description: OpenAI-compatible LLM MCP (7 tools); chat via balance key or x402 USDC on Base
summary: OpenAI-compatible LLM MCP (7 tools); chat via balance key or x402 USDC on Base
offersHint: OpenAI-compatible LLM MCP (7 tools); chat via balance key or x402 USDC on Base · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.lmxcloud.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Fetch current LMX Cloud per-call pricing catalog.

toolsPreview.name: quote_price
toolsPreview.description: Estimate USDC cost for a single model call. Uses GET /v1/pricing with model and token params.

toolsPreview.name: list_models
toolsPreview.description: List currently supported LMX model aliases and providers.

toolsPreview.name: get_status
toolsPreview.description: Fetch LMX Cloud provider health, fallback chain, and anchoring status.

toolsPreview.name: get_balance
toolsPreview.description: Fetch USD credit balance for the caller API key. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: get_usage
toolsPreview.description: Fetch request and token usage totals for the caller API key. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: web_search
toolsPreview.description: Real-time web search via LMX (Brave Search passthrough). Fixed per-call USDC price from the caller's API key balance. Returns title/url/snippet results.

toolsPreview.name: extract_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Extract text and light structure (title, headings, page count) from a PDF via LMX pdf-extract. Provide file_url and/or file_base64. Requires a real LMX API key (same gate as web_search).

toolsPreview.name: chat_completion
toolsPreview.description: Call LMX Cloud OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Prefers a pre-funded API key (Bearer / api_key); when omitted and x402 is enabled, requires a USDC pay-per-call payment. Optional image_url / images enable vision input (OpenAI content-parts format) — use a vision model such as llama-3.2-90b-vision, qwen-3.6-35b, or qwen-3.5-35b.
